title: Tao Te Ching
author: Laozi
description: Eighty-one short chapters on doing less and yielding first. In this 1891 translation by James Legge, it takes under an hour and repays years.
snippet: Ch. 1. 1. The Tao that can be trodden is not the enduring and unchanging Tao. The name that can be named is not the enduring and unchanging…
